claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Desoxycortone is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent at 2.5 uM; any weak killing is likely from low-affinity glucocorticoid receptor (NR3C1) agonism in glucocorticoid-sensitive hematopoietic/lymphoid lines rather than mineralocorticoid receptor-mediated cytotoxicity.
